messages:
Elena: Quick design check-in 1 roles matrix + invite drawer tweaks. Two priorities: density for admins (compact rows) and clearer seat wording. Figma: https://redwood.ai/figma/rbac-compact-v3

Rob: For compact rows we should collapse the permissions column into an inline chevron (expand on enter/click). Keep single-line by default. Hover card for effective permissions is fine but needs keyboard equivalent (enter to expand).

Tasha: UX copy: users read 'Seats' as purchased licenses. Recommend renaming to 'Assigned seats' and show '(active users)' as secondary text where space allows. In compact mode use 'Assigned'.

Miguel: Invite drawer notes: move SSO notice inline under the title + small badge next to Send. Badge must be focusable and open a tooltip: 'Org requires SSO. Invited users must sign in with SSO.' Also add a CSV dry-run that validates rows and lists per-row errors before sending.

A11yBot: Accessibility issues to fix before ship: 1) drawer focus trap currently breaks when SSO options open  make close button first tabbable and add aria-modal="true"; 2) toasts should use role="status" + aria-live="polite" and extend duration for screen readers; 3) badges need 4.5:1 contrast and visible focus styles; 4) hover permission previews must have keyboard trigger and aria-expanded state.

Elena: Action items: update mocks with inline SSO + badge, compact chevron expand (aria-controls + aria-expanded), rename Seats -> Assigned seats, add CSV sample + dry-run UI, and include keyboard shortcuts stub (g r, g i, g a). Will post updated spec and a short dev checklist. Thanks :thumbsup:
